cohort: The study included 120 consecutive pregnant women who were at or below 20 weeks of gestational age from 82 villages in Kaniyambadi block, Tamil Nadu.
finding: MTHFR gene polymorphisms, specifically c.1298A>C or c.677C>T variants, were associated with vitamin B12 deficiency, and the heterozygous pathogenic variant c.1262G>T was associated with both adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes.
